definitions.explanation: The screen of a device on which information is shown to the user — for example the panel of a smartphone, the monitor of a PC, or the LCD readout of an appliance. Often used in technical manuals and UI documentation to refer to whatever layout is currently visible on the screen.

examples.japanese: {表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧。
{表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: An error message appeared on the display screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧レイアウト⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧。
examples.english: When you change the settings, the layout of the display screen switches accordingly.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧ ('display; indication') and ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ ('screen'). Used in technical contexts — device manuals, software documentation, UI design — to refer to the currently visible screen or screen layout, as opposed to the physical hardware panel.

USAGE:
- Often refers to the logical content shown on the screen (a window, menu, or view), not just the physical surface.
- Frequently appears with verbs like ⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧ ('to switch'), ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}される→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧ ('to be displayed'), or ⟦{更新|こうしん}される→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧ ('to be updated').
- In user manuals, directions like 「{表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧」 ('Follow the instructions on the display') are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the display screen
- {表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わる→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧: the display screen switches
- {表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}される→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧: to be shown on the display screen
- {表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧: display screen settings
- {表示画面|ひょうじがめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: the display screen goes blank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: screen — the everyday, general word; {表示画面|ひょうじがめん} sounds more technical and specifies the display function.
- ⟦ディスプレイ→ディスプレイ：04891_disupurei⟧: display — loanword used especially for computer monitors or standalone displays.
- ⟦モニター→モニター：05105_monitaa⟧: monitor — usually a standalone computer or video monitor; a hardware term.
- ⟦{液晶画面|えきしょうがめん}→液晶画面：08741_ekishougamen⟧: LCD screen — specifies the panel technology; contrast with ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧EL⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (OLED screen).
- ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: display; indication — the base word; on its own, covers any kind of shown indication, not just a screen.
